value.os: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther (Power Mac G4 mac99)
value.kbd_note: Aqua desktop: the Dock and the Finder menu bar are the cheapest visible key/click proofs; Terminal gives a real Unix shell one click away.
value.note: TRUE ABSOLUTE pointer via -device usb-tablet (cursor_scale 1.0, offset 0,0): measured on the Panther installer framebuffer, abs events to (200,150) and (800,600) landed on those pixels and clicks activated the controls beneath them. Five-target sweep on the installed desktop is OPEN.

labctl.notes: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther under TCG on mac99. NO NIC by operator scope. Absolute pointer via usb-tablet. Reset is loadvm golden; warm system_reset is not trusted on -M mac99 (see macos9).

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# macosx (VMID 218) — Mac OS X 10.3 Panther on a PowerPC G4 mac99 under TCG,
# on the standalone /opt/qemu-ppc fork build. True absolute pointer (usb-tablet).

deviceSetSummary: -nic none (deliberate: no networking on this station)
-device usb-tablet (MEASURED absolute pointer; macos9 cannot do this)
(built-in via=pmu USB keyboard; NO extra -device usb-kbd/usb-mouse)

launcherParity.reason: the tracked verbatim launcher IS the deployed launcher; the golden was baked 2026-09-20 with this exact device set on the standalone /opt/qemu-ppc build carrying the cpu/tb_env vmstate patch — a pre-patch binary resumes a PowerPC checkpoint with the timebase jumped forward, so any binary change means a cold re-bake

reset.fixture: Quiet Mac OS 9.2.2 Finder desktop at 1024x768, millions of colors (Power Mac G4 mac99 under TCG): Macintosh HD top-right, empty Trash bottom-right, no window open, nothing selected, Control Strip along the bottom, cursor parked dead-centre (512,384). Energy Saver sleep pinned to Never; Mouse tracking pinned to 'Very Slow' (the only non-accelerated setting, linear 0.18 px/unit) and double-click speed slowest so a click pair survives the stream; Setup Assistant quit and disarmed. Re-baked cold 2026-08-24 on the tb_env-patched fork binary and captured by checkpoint-guard; restore-proven by the strict protocol — fresh QEMU process, the guest's own menubar clock advancing across two ticks, then pointer motion consumed on the framebuffer (SSIM alone passes on a wedged guest and proves nothing).

spa.eraLabel: 2003 · Mac OS X 10.3 Panther — Power Mac G4

museum.blurb: Aqua arrives: Apple’s NeXT-derived Unix foundation becomes the Macintosh, with protected memory, the Dock and a rebuilt Finder on the same PowerPC machine as the classic Mac OS it replaced.
museum.notes: Mac OS X 10.3 Panther on QEMU mac99 under TCG. 10.2 Jaguar was the first target and panics on this machine inside IOSCSIMultimediaCommandsDevice/IODVDStorageFamily (its ATAPI CD stack cannot drive the emulated optical device) — do not switch back. Unlike macos9 this guest drives QEMU’s usb-tablet natively, so the pointer is truly absolute. No networking, deliberately.

emulator.source: github.com/Wnt/qemu @ kernel-hive (11.0.2 + fast-poll + cpu/tb_env vmstate), built to /opt/qemu-ppc

network.note: NO NIC AT ALL (-nic none, which suppresses QEMU's default user-mode sungem on mac99). Operator scope for this add: ordinary station first — no retronet, no networking. The guest's TCP/IP and AppleTalk control panels were never configured. The golden is baked with this device set; adding a NIC later means a cold re-bake (chokanji/macos753 pattern).

notes: PAUSED BEFORE GOLDEN (wave 2026-09-20, labhost load rule). Media, release choice (Panther over Jaguar) and pointer transport (usb-tablet, true absolute) are MEASURED; the OS install itself was not run and no golden exists. Disabled candidate on purpose. See docs/lab/MACOSX-WAVE.md.
